title: Ready, episode 3: what they will see
worry: Fear of what they will see online

beats.quote: I want them to come to me first.
beats.source: What parents tell us they want most

beats.line: Something horrible in the group chat.

beats.me: She showed me a horrible message from a group chat. What do I say?
digi: Thank her for coming to you first. That is the win.
Then ask what she thinks it means, before you decide anything.

beats.line: Log the worry. See how it moves, week by week.
She came to you, not around you.
